recipes.label: drowning resolved
recipes.startdescription: I feel the pull of the current lessen, the wave of confusion starts to subside. The balance between my instincts and rationality begins to restore.
recipes.description: A breath of fresh air fills my lungs as I resurface from the overwhelming waves of wantonness and analysis paralysis. The waters of life seem more navigable now.

recipes.label: drowning resolved
recipes.startdescription: With a final push, I break through the surface. The sweet taste of air floods my senses, and I see the horizon with a clarity I've not known before.
recipes.description: I have fought against the current and emerged victorious. The balance between instinct and analysis, wantonness and paralysis, has been restored. The flow state is within my grasp. I have navigated the tumultuous waters and have been rewarded with renewed strength and insight.
